title: GitHub connection
description: Choose your GitHub account in your web browser. GitHub will identify the authorization helper as Git Credential Manager.
privacy: Credentials are protected by this computer’s credential store. They are not sent to Seigr or included in workspace copies or published websites.
permissions: Git Credential Manager requests repository, workflow and gist access. Your organization may require approval before its repositories are available.
disconnected: No GitHub account is connected to this workspace.
waiting: Finish signing in in your web browser. You can choose the GitHub account you want to use there.
saving: Protecting your connection on this computer…
forgetHint: Forgetting removes Observanda’s saved credential and disconnects this account from all Observanda workspaces on this computer.
unavailable: Browser sign-in needs the bundled Git Credential Manager and Git runtime. Use a current Observanda installation.
tokenHint: For managed or headless installations, you can use a token with access to your repository. It stays in memory until disconnect or restart. Pages setup also needs Pages and Administration write permissions.
temporary: A temporary token is connected for this session.
